summary_markdown:
The discussion centered on the process of migrating or transferring `device_session` records (sessions) from one data box to another. A specific SQL query was reviewed for copying session data, particularly addressing how to handle company and facility number mapping using `dictGetUInt32`. The main difficulty identified was incorporating a third required table into the transfer script.

[me] confirmed that the provided scripts only contained data for the second table, not the sessions themselves. [p1] later retrieved an updated script (`ch/_scripts/update/session_reinsert.sql`) which was pushed by [me].
decisions: The session transfer process requires updating the SQL script to correctly handle all necessary tables (including a third table, if required).
A new script, `ch/_scripts/update/session_reinsert.sql`, was provided for the data migration.
action_items: Review and implement the updated session re-insertion script.
Verify the complete transfer process across all required tables (including the third table).
